##### Project general facts

Augusta by Nshama Group is a contemporary residential development in Town Square Dubai, offering a collection of thoughtfully designed one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, as well as spacious three-bedroom duplexes. Set near Town Square Park, the project combines modern architecture with a strong sense of community, creating a balanced lifestyle where urban energy meets green open spaces. With elegant design lines, bright interiors, and seamless access to the surrounding retail, dining, and entertainment options, Augusta is designed to meet the needs of modern residents seeking both comfort and connectivity.

Residents benefit from a vibrant, family-friendly environment enriched by parks, recreational trails, playgrounds, swimming pools, and easy access to schools and healthcare facilities. This well-rounded setting encourages an active and convenient lifestyle, while the development’s close connection to the wider Town Square community ensures that leisure, wellness, and everyday essentials are always within easy reach.

Each residence is finished with high-quality contemporary materials that reflect the project’s modern and practical design approach. The apartments come with German-made kitchen appliances and are delivered unfurnished, giving homeowners the flexibility to personalize their interiors while enjoying a stylish and well-appointed home in one of Dubai’s most dynamic residential communities.

##### Location description and benefits

Town Square Dubai is a vibrant and expansive mega-development located in the heart of Dubai. At the core of Town Square Dubai is the picturesque Town Square Park, which serves as the central hub for residents and visitors alike. The park features lush green spaces, jogging tracks, and play areas, providing a refreshing escape from the urban hustle and creating a sense of unity and community spirit.

Town Square Dubai boasts a host of exceptional facilities and amenities, making it a vibrant and dynamic place to live. Residents can enjoy access to sports courts, fitness centers, swimming pools, as well as retail and dining outlets within the community. A Town Square Mall, with a variety of shops and entertainment options, further enriches the living experience.

The development's strategic location provides easy connectivity to major highways, ensuring convenient access to other parts of Dubai. Additionally, Town Square Dubai is within proximity to schools, hospitals, and other essential services, offering residents a well-connected and comprehensive lifestyle.
